key_insight: Hybrid PQC-QKD designs aim to keep session keys secure if either the computational layer or the physical quantum layer remains secure, but their real value depends on how the two components are combined and authenticated.
engineering_relevance: The paper gives engineers a practical taxonomy and comparison framework for selecting, standardizing, and deploying quantum-safe key exchange across TLS, MACsec, and IKEv2-style systems.
method: Define an 8-dimension taxonomy for PQC-QKD hybrids
Compare published protocols, standards, and combiner designs against a common security grid
Survey deployment evidence from QKD testbeds and networks
evidence_signal: The abstract synthesizes protocol literature, standards guidance, and deployment reports, but does not present a new experimental benchmark or numerical evaluation.
watch_item: A major implementation concern is authenticating the QKD classical channel and proving security under shared-infrastructure and real-world deployment assumptions.
paper_title: Combining Post-Quantum Cryptography and Quantum Key Distribution: Taxonomy, Constructions, Proofs, Standards, Deployments and Open Problems
